Bangladesh’s major political parties have reacted minimally to the execution of two Bangladeshis in Saudi Arabia with leaders of the ruling BNP, parliamentary opposition 
Jamaat-e-Islami and the National Citizen Party (NCP), remaining largely silent.

Smaller parties, including the Communist Party of Bangladesh (CPB) and Rashtra Sanskar Andolan, have protested,

CPB, Bangladesher Samajtantrik Dal and other left-leaning parties called the hartal after the Bangladesh Energy Regulatory Commission on November 23 raised the power tariff by 5.3 percent.
